notes.f1: R21 links John Swarbrick (L88T-VT4, ~1764-1830, of Carleton) to Robert; ps_001 names him as father.
notes.f2: R22 links Grace Collinson (P6MH-1N8) to Robert, with the John + Grace couple (R2) kept; ps_001 names her as mother.
notes.f3: Christening 20 Dec 1797 at Poulton le Fylde recorded on Robert and the twin named in ps_001, but no birth fact, St. Chad not named in the fact, and the twin John (I4) left unlinked.
notes.f4: Robert's father is John, not William, but the rejected Hambleton family was written into the tree: I1 Robert (chr. 11 Jun 1797, Hambleton) with parents I2 William Swarbrick and I3 Ann (R19/R20).
